title: Recursive binary row elimination
statement: For a finite type of variables, the procedure takes an ordered list of variables and a list of linear equations over the two-element field. It recursively processes the variables, using the pivot-extraction and row-clearing operations at each step, and returns the resulting pivot list, residual rows, and a recursively accumulated natural-number work count.
hypotheses_covered: The variable type has decidable equality
caveat: The definitions of pivot extraction and row clearing are not included, so their exact operations cannot be stated.
